transcript.text: On May 3, 2021, Bill Nelson was sworn in as NASA Administrator.
In 2 years, NASA made history ...
and we’re just getting started.
Throughout America's story, there are defining days ...
We have touch down!
Days when minds change, hearts fill
and imagination soar.
Days when visions transformed the trajectory of the American story,
which is our story.
It's a new era of star
sailors, thinkers and adventurers.
James Webb begins a voyage back to the birth of the universe.
These images are going to remind the world
that there's nothing beyond our capacity.
Every image is a new discovery.
The space station is critical to our future of learning
how to live off our home planet.
And we have an impact! [cheering]
A giant leap for humanity in the  name of planetary defense.
DART is actually showing us the beginnings
of our strategy around protecting the planet.
And liftoff.
Doing what is hard and achieving what is great -
that is what stirs humankind.
That's what unites us.
No herculean effort is too large.
No moonshot is beyond our reach.
[music is suspensful and then builds]
And liftoff of Artemis I.
The Artemis Generation stands ready,
ready to return humanity to the moon.
And then to take us further than ever before
- to Mars.
[Epic music]
We have invited other peoples of the Earth
to join us in this great
international adventure.
[music climax]
Let us continue
to find unity in our discovery.
So together, let us continue to dream
the impossible dream that now becomes real.
And then let us traverse
the untouched terrain of the
once unreachable stars.
